derivation_rule.description: Apply the Protocol v1 SRF to DER contract by deriving a bounded evidence statement only from the declared OpenFGA SRF surfaces and their BOR observation references.

derived_claim.claim: Given the observed OpenFGA execution surfaces, the referenced SRF supports the bounded evidence statement that OpenFGA documents an authorization model/configuration language for object types and relationships, a write authorization model entry point that creates a new version, and a model version boundary where authorization models are immutable after creation.

provenance.notes: Canonical Reference DER: first reference execution of the frozen SRF to DER contract for one selected B2 SRF. Remaining DER records will be produced separately.
